# Trackly

> Trackly (trackly.today) is a free, offline-first all-in-one daily life tracker. It runs as a progressive web app (PWA) on iPhone, Android and desktop — installable in about 30 seconds without an app store. Made by ahexa.studio.
>
> Who built Trackly? Trackly (trackly.today) was founded and developed by ahexa.studio in 2026. Full story: https://trackly.today/about

## What Trackly is

Trackly replaces a handful of single-purpose apps with one clean, distraction-free tracker for personal life management. Everything works offline and syncs to the user's private account when online. An AI assistant can answer questions about the user's own data and add entries conversationally (English or Hinglish).

## Key facts

- URL: https://trackly.today
- App: https://trackly.today/app (free account required)
- Expense tracker page: https://trackly.today/expense-tracker
- Habit tracker page: https://trackly.today/habit-tracker
- Money tracker page (kharcha & udhaar, Hinglish): https://trackly.today/money-tracker
- Install guide: https://trackly.today/install
- Price: free to use, no credit card required
- Platforms: Web / iOS (Safari Add to Home Screen) / Android (Chrome Install)
- Offline-first: data is stored on-device and syncs automatically
- Privacy: accounts are private by default; sync is encrypted; users can export or permanently delete their data
- Publisher / maker: ahexa.studio (founded Trackly in 2026)
- About page: https://trackly.today/about

## Core features (complete list — full detail at https://trackly.today/features)

Money & expenses:
- Quick Add: log expenses in ~5 seconds ("momo 70", "petrol 500") with auto-parsed category, amount, date
- Categories and payment methods (cash / UPI / card) on every entry
- Monthly budgets with live spend tracking and savings view
- Reports: daily, weekly, monthly, with category breakdowns
- Borrow & lend (udhaar) ledger: who owes whom, settle up
- Trip mode: national/international trips with isolated expense tracking

AI assistant:
- Chat about the user's own data ("aaj kharcha kitna hua?", "what did I spend on food this week?")
- Mass-add entries ("add momo 70, biryani 78, auto 40")
- Actions: creates expenses, tasks and calendar events from a sentence
- Works in English, Hindi and Hinglish (Roman-script Hindi), matching the user's style per message
- Student mode: study assistant that knows exam dates and subjects, plans revision
- Free tier: 30 AI messages/day; premium accounts unlimited

Habits, routines & tasks:
- Habits with daily check-ins and streak counters
- Morning/night routines with timed tasks and "what's next" card
- Tasks: priorities, repeats, due dates, 3-state flow (todo → in progress → done)
- Calendar: events and meetings in one day view
- Medicine reminders: schedule names and times, fire offline
- Notification center with expense, habit and task alerts

Notes & shopping:
- Notes: searchable, synced
- Shopping lists: quantity, price, bought state
- Global search across everything the user has logged

Group expenses (a free Splitwise alternative):
- Groups for flat-shares, trips and dinner circles; members join via invite link
- Equal or custom splits per expense
- Live balances (who owes whom) and settle-up with history
- Per-group expense sheets

Student mode (11 tools):
- Attendance: subject-wise percentage, safe-skip calculation, CRITICAL/LOW warnings
- Assignments: deadlines with days-left math and status
- Subjects & study planner: chapter progress
- Exams: timetable with live countdowns (date, time, hall)
- Books: pages read vs total, reading progress
- Mess planner: daily meal tracking
- Hostel rent: records with 7-day reminders, mark paid
- Student budget: pocket money with savings
- Class routine: period-wise daily timetable
- AI study assistant
- Student data stays isolated from personal data

Office mode (7 tools):
- Work tasks with due-today defaults
- Office attendance: check-in/check-out, weekly percentage
- Salary finance: salary + extras − deductions, Indian number format, savings goal, mark-as-received
- Office calendar: meetings and work events
- Productivity: 25-minute pomodoro focus timer with pause/resume
- Office analytics: tasks per day, spend per day
- Work data stays isolated from personal data

Platform:
- Offline-first PWA: entries save on-device instantly, sync when online; installs on iPhone (Safari → Add to Home Screen) and Android (Chrome → Install) in ~30 seconds, no app store
- English + Hinglish app language toggle; dark and light themes
- Export everything (CSV/JSON) or permanently delete the account from settings
- Widgets, archive, trash with recovery, referrals, live demo without an account

## Common questions

- Is Trackly free? Yes — core tracking is free, no credit card needed.
- Does it work offline? Yes — offline-first with automatic cloud sync.
- How do I install it? iPhone: open trackly.today in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Android: Chrome → Install.
- Is my data private? Yes — private by default, encrypted sync, full export/delete in Settings.
